title: iberis intermedia subsp. violletii
intro: Iberis intermedia subsp. violletii, commonly known as Candytuft, is a type of flowering plant in the Brassicaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion, due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to soothe skin irritations and wounds, and its use as a natural antiseptic. Bioactive constituents of Candytuft include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
